name: Studio Three

plans.name: Flex 4
plans.note: Four classes a month. 30-day terms, no commitment. Studio Three does not publish an enrollment or annual fee.

plans.name: Off-Peak
plans.note: Unlimited classes at off-peak times only. Studio Three does not publish an enrollment or annual fee on its pricing or FAQ pages; neither is confirmed either way.

plans.name: U27
plans.note: Unlimited classes for members aged 27 and under. Studio Three does not publish an enrollment or annual fee on its pricing or FAQ pages; neither is confirmed either way.

plans.name: Couples
plans.note: Per person, for two members at one address; proof of partnership required. Studio Three does not publish an enrollment or annual fee on its pricing or FAQ pages; neither is confirmed either way.

plans.name: All Access
plans.note: Unlimited classes, 30-day terms, no commitment. Studio Three does not publish an enrollment or annual fee on its pricing or FAQ pages; neither is confirmed either way.

plans.name: Early Booking
plans.note: Unlimited classes with early booking privileges. Studio Three does not publish an enrollment or annual fee on its pricing or FAQ pages; neither is confirmed either way.

class_packs.name: 50-class pack
class_packs.note: Fifty classes, valid one year. Packs are usable at Studio Three locations in Austin and Chicago.

class_packs.name: 3-class intro
class_packs.note: $60 for three classes, new customers only.

sourcing_notes: Neither fee is confirmed either way: the pricing and FAQ pages state neither, so both are recorded as none rather than as unknowns.
